tone.summary: A highly transparent signal chain using minimal pre-amp boost and a pristine clean amp model (US Deluxe) paired with an open cabinet simulation, focusing on clarity and natural acoustic tone.

rig.name: Georges Brassens - Les copains d'abord - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Minimal noise gating to maintain the natural acoustic sound.
Gentle compression to even out the dynamics of fingerpicking and enhance clarity, mimicking close-mic recording.
blocks.gap: The ideal tool would be a dedicated acoustic preamp/EQ, but Comp provides necessary dynamic control without adding coloration.

blocks.purpose: Bypass all gain stages to maintain the dry acoustic character.
Selecting a clean, articulate amp model suitable for delicate acoustic tones.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the cleanest option available; however, dedicated acoustic amps would be ideal to avoid electric coloration.

blocks.purpose: Providing a focused and articulate cabinet simulation suitable for close-mic acoustic recording.
blocks.gap: A dedicated small-diaphragm condenser mic IR would be better, but US 2x12 provides the necessary clean voicing.

blocks.purpose: Subtly boosting the upper mids and highs to enhance fingerpicking clarity and definition.
Bypass all filtering to maintain the natural acoustic timbre.
Bypass all modulation effects (Chorus, Tremolo) as per the source material's requirement for dryness.
Adding the absolute minimum amount of natural room ambience to prevent the sound from being sterile, while respecting the 'minimal room' constraint.
blocks.gap: The ideal setting is near zero reverb; this provides a subtle sense of space without muddying the intimate tone.

improvements.summary: Replace generic IR/Cab with dedicated acoustic condenser mic simulation for maximum clarity and intimacy.

proposals.reason: Enhance fingerpicking clarity and intimate studio sound.
